summary: We help businesses and organizations screen, process and onboard the people who want to join them, as members or as employees. We follow each client's own guidelines, not a one-size template.
audience: Businesses and organizations that bring in new members or employees and want help with screening, paperwork and setup. It suits small teams where onboarding tends to fall to whoever has a spare hour.
problem:
Before: onboarding is somebody's second job. Some weeks applications sit, forms go missing, and a good person loses interest while they wait to hear back. Each new person gets a different start depending on who happened to handle them.
After: candidates are pre-qualified against the criteria the client hands over, paperwork and setup are handled with their team, and applicants know what comes next. Everyone gets the same start.
moments:
Applications have been sitting and nobody has had time to reply.
Forms went missing and a new person couldn't get set up.
A good applicant lost interest while waiting to hear back.
They're taking on new members or employees and it all lands on one desk.
offerings:
Intro to Onboarding: a weekly session that walks through how K.A.P.I.T Global's onboarding works
Onboarding & Integration from K.A.P.I.T Global: candidate pre-qualification and screening, paperwork and setup for prospective members and employees, following the client's own guidelines
howItRuns:
Intro to Onboarding runs once a week. The day, time and how to join are given on the free call.
The onboarding service follows the client's own steps, so how long it takes depends on those steps.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team. It helps to bring your current onboarding steps, even if they're only a rough list. After the call, if it's a fit, the team explains the next steps before you agree to anything.
faqs:
Q: Will you follow our own process?
A: Yes. Bring your current steps to the call, even if it's only a rough list for now.

Q: How long does onboarding take?
A: It depends on your own steps. Ask on your free call.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: The team goes through K.A.P.I.T Global's fees with you on the call. If you're a good fit, you may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship toward this offer.

Q: When is Intro to Onboarding?
A: Once a week. Ask on your free call for the day, time and how to join.

Q: What happens on the call?
A: The team asks how you bring new people in today and answers your questions. There's no obligation.
aboutYou:
We're K.A.P.I.T Global, an independent onboarding company. We work through our own K.A.P.I.T Framework: Knowledge, Action, Passion, Implementation and Transformation. The aim is a structured, consistent onboarding process for every client, so each new person gets the same start.
Criztal, a NowTRANSFORMED Coach, brings our service to NowTRANSFORMED, a youth leadership development program.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
Don't promise how long onboarding will take. It depends on each client's own steps.
Don't promise that the people we screen will work out or stay.
Don't present K.A.P.I.T Global as part of NowTRANSFORMED. It's an independent company.
